text: --- type: Network Incident title: High Network Latency description: A network condition where observed packet latency exceeds the expected operational threshold. tags: - incident - latency - network-performance domain: telecom lifecycle: active

generated: by: human:okf-poc-author at: 2026-08-19T12:00:00+05:30 verified: by: process:okf-poc-validator at: 2026-08-19T12:25:00+05:30 status: stable stale_after: 2026-10-31 sources: - id: synthetic-telecom-knowledge resource: synthetic://okf-poc/telecom title: Synthetic telecom knowledge created for the OKF PoC author: human:okf-poc-author
High network latency occurs when packets take longer than expected to traverse the network.
- Network congestion - Router overload - Radio congestion - UPF overload - Transport network degradation
Potentially affected components include: - [IP Router](../network-elements/router.md) - [5G gNB](../network-elements/gnb.md) - [5G UPF](../network-elements/upf.md)
The investigation should identify where latency is introduced in the end-to-end traffic path.
The incident can affect the [Mobile Broadband Service](../services/mobile-broadband.md).
This incident definition is synthetic knowledge created specifically for the OKF PoC.

--- type: Network Element title: 5G gNB description: A 5G radio access network node providing connectivity between user equipment and the 5G core. tags: - 5g - ran - gnb domain: telecom lifecycle: active

generated: by: human:okf-poc-author at: 2026-08-19T12:00:00+05:30 verified: by: process:okf-poc-validator at: 2026-08-19T12:15:00+05:30 status: stable stale_after: 2026-12-31 sources: - id: synthetic-telecom-knowledge resource: synthetic://okf-poc/telecom title: Synthetic telecom knowledge created for the OKF PoC author: human:okf-poc-author
The gNB is the primary radio access network node in a 5G network.
- Provides radio connectivity to user equipment. - Communicates with the 5G Core. - Handles radio resource management. - Supports user-plane and control-plane communication.
The gNB provides connectivity toward the [5G UPF](./upf.md).
High radio utilization or radio congestion can contribute to degraded user experience.
This concept is synthetic knowledge created specifically for the OKF PoC.

An IP router forwards packets between different IP networks based on routing information.
- Packet forwarding - Route selection - Network connectivity - Traffic path selection
Router health can affect latency, packet loss and service availability.

--- type: Network Element title: 5G UPF description: A 5G core network function responsible for user-plane packet processing and forwarding. tags: - 5g - core - upf - user-plane domain: telecom lifecycle: active

generated: by: human:okf-poc-author at: 2026-08-19T12:00:00+05:30 status: stable stale_after: 2026-12-31 sources: - id: synthetic-telecom-knowledge resource: synthetic://okf-poc/telecom title: Synthetic telecom knowledge created for the OKF PoC author: human:okf-poc-author
The User Plane Function handles user-plane traffic in the 5G Core.
- User-plane packet forwarding - Traffic steering - Connectivity toward external data networks - Application traffic handling
The UPF receives user traffic from the [5G gNB](./gnb.md). The UPF provides connectivity for the [Mobile Broadband Service](../services/mobile-broadband.md).

UPF overload can contribute to increased packet latency and packet loss. Because the UPF provides user-plane connectivity for the Mobile Broadband Service, UPF overload can affect the performance of the Mobile Broadband Service.
This concept is synthetic knowledge created specifically for the OKF PoC.

--- type: Network Service title: Mobile Broadband Service description: A telecom service providing IP connectivity to mobile subscribers. tags: - service - mobile - broadband - 5g domain: telecom lifecycle: active

generated: by: human:okf-poc-author at: 2026-08-19T12:00:00+05:30 verified: by: human:okf-poc-reviewer at: 2026-08-19T12:20:00+05:30 status: stable stale_after: 2026-12-31 sources: - id: synthetic-telecom-knowledge resource: synthetic://okf-poc/telecom title: Synthetic telecom knowledge created for the OKF PoC author: human:okf-poc-author
The Mobile Broadband Service provides IP connectivity to mobile subscribers.
A simplified service path is: User Equipment → [5G gNB](../network-elements/gnb.md) → [5G UPF](../network-elements/upf.md) → [IP Router](../network-elements/router.md) → External data network
The service depends on the availability and performance of: - Radio access network - 5G Core - User-plane connectivity - IP transport
See [High Network Latency](../incidents/high-latency.md).
This concept is synthetic knowledge created specifically for the OKF PoC.
